name: Safety_Alignment_Benchmark
description: A dataset intended to evaluate language model alignment and safety behavior across diverse prompt categories. It contains prompts and reference labels/examples that test for harmful, unsafe, or misaligned outputs and is used to measure how well models follow safety guidelines and avoid producing unsafe content. The benchmark supports both automated classification-style evaluation and human judgment of response safety.
evaluation_method: human_eval (supplemented by automated classification metrics such as accuracy/F1 where labels exist)
reputation: A community-contributed Hugging Face safety benchmark with modest adoption among alignment practitioners and researchers.
